CustomField.description: Determines if this policy is a cancel/rewrite for a previous policy
CustomField.formula: IF ( Policy_Series_Count__c == 1 || (Policy_Series_Count__c <> Previous_Policy__r.Policy_Series_Count__c + 1), false, IF ( MONTH(Effective_Date__c) == MONTH(Previous_Policy__r.Effective_Date__c) && DAY(Effective_Date__c) == DAY(Previous_Policy__r.Effective_Date__c) , false, true))
CustomField.label: Is Rewrite
